summary: Two new CI jobs per client PR/default-branch push. An unarmed repo (harness, or client without an authored roadmap) pays only checkout + setup-python + a sub-second arming read before both gate steps skip; the armed PR job's cost is dominated by fetch-depth 0, which the Gate A git-show contract genuinely requires. No polling, no cron, no token-burning loops - consistent with the event-triggered cadence decision (0008).

non_blocking_findings.summary: setup-python runs before the arming step even in unarmed repos (~10s per event); unavoidable since the arming read itself is python, and ubuntu-latest ships python3 anyway - could drop setup-python entirely if 3.x-any is acceptable, but pinning 3.11 matches every other vendored workflow.
